components.name: FaithfulCard
components.summary: A card that shows Markdown from an untrusted result under a content policy, with link and image consent, for answers that need their sources and limits kept visible.

components.name: ActionButton
components.summary: A control whose layout names no action. The application attaches an action to each rendered instance, so one definition serves every row while each row keeps its own state.

entries.role: Renderer-neutral contract of the control: a strict schema with no action property

preview.caption: Two ActionButton instances in a row of the notes application's layout. Neither names an action.

qualification.statement: No guide of this release records a renderer or host qualification for this control.

componentExclusions.name: Typed surfaces
componentExclusions.reason: `Surface`, `openSurface` and the stack's `defineSurface` compose and bind a surface. They are APIs, not components an application places in a layout.

componentExclusions.name: Layout and basic components
componentExclusions.reason: Row, Column, List and the other basic components come from the upstream A2UI v0.9 catalog that the renderer packages forward. The SDK does not document them as its own.
